title: Absolutely Terrible Sheet Set
text: Absolutely Terrible Sheet Set. Washed these twice before using them. I honestly checked the label and packaging sure I had been sent the wrong item. In a way they feel like nylon but, the top sheet especially, they sometimes feel like tent canvas. They're loud and crinkley and the don't breathe! I specifically sought out percale sheets because they're supposed to have a cooler, more open, weave. These are hotter than my jersey sheets! Uncomfortable. Hot. Noisy. The worst sheets I've ever slept under. The only saving grace was the company's refund policy.
